items.problem: The `validate_item_change` and `after_item_change` lists are "one per item" (item-ledger.md:176-180), and an `exchange_items` item whose net change is 0 has no `ItemChange` and no history row (item-ledger.md:53). Nothing says whether that item is in the hook lists (with before = after) or whether its balance row is saved again. So whether a hook sees a net-0 item can differ per implementation. This is the same before this diff for net-0 changes at balances ≤ `max_amount`

Whether the hook lists include an `exchange_items` item whose net change is 0 is not set. Lines 176 to 177 give "one element per item" and line 180 says each item is in the list only once, but line 53 drops such an item only from `ItemChange` and the history. Input: a content `validate_item_change` that returns a `GameError` when item X is in the list; `exchange_items` subtracts X 1 and adds X 1. One implementation passes X with `before` = `after` and the result is `REJECTED`. Another leaves X out and the result is `OK`. This was already the case before the diff (line 53 is not changed)
